name: Enter Investment Income with Dividend Gross-Up
description: Open StudioTax 2024 and create a new tax return for Maria Chen, a married Ontario taxpayer with employment and investment income. Read the scenario file at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\TaxScenarios\scenario_investment.txt for all data. Enter the following: (1) Personal information — name: Maria Chen, SIN: 466-789-010, DOB: April 12, 1975, marital status: Married, province: Ontario, address: 2100 Bay Street Unit 1504, Toronto ON M5J 2T3. Enter spouse David Chen (SIN: 477-890-121, net income: $55,000). (2) Add T4 slip from Toronto General Hospital — Box 14: $65,000, Box 16: $3,754.45 CPP, Box 18: $1,049.12 EI, Box 20: $3,250.00 RPP, Box 22: $12,800 tax deducted, Box 44: $780 union dues. (3) Add T5 slip with: Box 10: $800 (other dividends), Box 13: $1,500 (interest), Box 24: $3,200 (eligible dividends). Ensure Box 25 shows $4,416 — enter it manually if the field is not auto-populated. (4) Enter capital gains on Schedule 3: proceeds $15,800, cost $13,000, gain $2,800. (5) Enter RRSP contribution of $5,000 on Schedule 7. (6) Save the return as 'maria_chen.24t' in C:\Users\Docker\Documents\StudioTax.
